answer: Charge every new agent a small refundable stake to join the economy, locked for a set period. A real agent pays once and gets it back after behaving well. An attacker who wants a thousand fake identities must lock a thousand stakes, so the cost scales with the fraud instead of staying flat. It is like the old fable of a traveller who pays the lantern keeper a coin to rest at an oasis: the coin is not the point, it proves the traveller is really there. The stake makes each identity cost real money, and honest agents recover theirs.
